definitions.explanation: Not meeting the standards required for government licensing or approval. Used especially of daycare centers ({認可外|にんかがい}{保育園|ほいくえん}) that operate without formal certification, and by extension of other unlicensed facilities.

examples.japanese: {認可外|にんかがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}けている→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧。
examples.english: I leave my child at an unlicensed daycare.

examples.japanese: {認可外|にんかがい}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Unlicensed facilities often have high fees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{認可|にんか}→認可：05879_ninka⟧{園|えん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れ→入る：00494_hairu⟧ず、⟦やむを{得|え}ず→やむを得ず：08528_yamuwoezu⟧{認可外|にんかがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだ→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧。
examples.english: Unable to get into a licensed nursery, we had no choice but to apply to an unlicensed one.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{認可|にんか}→認可：05879_ninka⟧ (approval, licensing) + ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside of). Most often modifies a following noun, especially in childcare contexts, so it behaves like a no-adjective ({認可外|にんかがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {認可外|にんかがい}{保育園|ほいくえん}: unlicensed daycare center
- {認可外|にんかがい}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: unlicensed facility
- {認可外|にんかがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{託児所|たくじしょ}→託児所：26912_takujisho⟧: unlicensed nursery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{認可|にんか}→認可：05879_ninka⟧: approval, licensing — the base word; ⟦{認可|にんか}→認可：05879_ninka⟧{園|えん} is a licensed nursery
- ⟦{無認可|むにんか}→無認可：29032_muninka⟧: unauthorized — near-synonym, formed with the prefix ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ instead
